dct_description_sm: These measurements were made to determine the melt rate of the Ward Hunt Ice Shelf and the Ward Hunt Ice Rise at the northernmost coast in Canada.  These types of measurements were made sporadically in the 1950s-80s but the existing networks were vastly improved in 2002 by Parks Canada and Carsten Braun on the Ward Hunt Ice Rise and in 2004 by ArcticNet/Parks Canada and Derek Mueller on the Ward Hunt Ice Shelf.
dct_title_s: Ward Hunt Ice Shelf and Ice Rise surface mass balance
